methodology:
Build knowledge/d1-d11-surface-verdicts-20261024.json.

Reproducible, read-only recomputation of a per-surface verdict for all 2558
D1-D11 human-readable surfaces declared in lib/domains/d1..d11.lisp.

Method (deterministic, evidence = file+line or knowledge coordinate):
  1. name-match : a surface alias (uk/ukr/san/en/LISP) equals a top-level
     (визначити <name>) definition name in lib/**.lisp  -> lives under a name.
  2. selector   : a proved selector/composition law (d5 selector status,
     d8/d9/d10 semantic inventories' SELECTOR-* source_class or
     SEMANTIC-GENERATOR relation_class, d9/d10/d11 selector seeds)
     -> executable as composition/selector.
  3. deferred   : a research candidate explicitly not executed / awaiting
     adjudication, or a by-design non-callable domain (D1 bit, D2 structure,
     D7 text data) -> intentionally deferred.
  4. true absence: proven nowhere. Count is 0 (no proof of absence found).
  5. undetermined: semantic identity asserted in knowledge but no verified
     implementation counterpart found -> undetermined, with reason.

No counterpart is invented: anything not backed by a concrete definition
(file+line) or a concrete knowledge coordinate is reported as undetermined.
caveats: Input CSVs referenced by the task (/scratch/input/sens_true_stub_candidates.csv and companions) were NOT present in the sandbox; the exact 592-row membership could not be loaded. This artifact is an independent, reproducible recomputation over all 2558 surfaces, not the subagent's set.
No counterpart is invented. Only a concrete lib/**.lisp definition (file+line) or a concrete knowledge coordinate counts as evidence.
true-absence count is 0: no surface was proven absent everywhere.
